_comment: Golden corpus for the REAL citation spec. Read by backend/tests/test_spec_golden.py and frontend/src/utils/__tests__/specGolden.test.js, so the Python and JavaScript engines are held to the same answers. Expected outputs follow the examples in the cited guides (AALL 2025, Suffolk, Georgetown, UNC) and the 21st edition. Inputs are normalised (curly quotes, en dashes) before matching, as the application does.
